meta.description: Adds breadcrumbs while navigating deep stacks

css: .fm-crumbs { position: fixed; top: 12px; right: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-surface, #0f162b) 80%, #ffffff 20%); border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); font-size: 0.9rem; }
